To: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>

Date: Mon, 12 Apr 2027 07:52:00 +0100
Subject: EMEA/APAC visibility rollup: action items and finance cutoff

Team —

Quick one: finance needs a reconciled view of committed ARR and best-case bookings for EMEA + APAC by EOD my time (15:00 BST) tomorrow so they can close the regional ledger for Q2 planning. I’ve attached a working commit matrix — please do a single-pass update to your rows and return.

What I need from each owner (Marcus/Laura/Vanessa/Karthik):
- Confirm stage (Proposal/Verbal/Contract Sent/Closed-Won) and put the precise dollar figure in the "Commit" column.
- Note any gating items (procurement, SOC2 evidence, PO received) in the comments column.
- Flag any deals that we should treat as soft commitments (i.e., not yet finance-closeable).

Attachments: EMEA_APAC_commit_matrix.xlsx (spreadsheet), Finance_cutoff_calendar.ics (calendar stub).

I'll collate and escalate any holes to the reps and procurement. If you can't hit the 15:00 BST deadline, respond with ETA and reason.

Thanks —
Mina
Mina Haddad
Senior Sales Operations Manager
Redwood Inference

Appreciate the fast updates team — collated and sent a single-sheet rollup to finance. Key callouts:
- Total EMEA commit (finance-closeable): $300,000 (CW-EN01 + ZEN-OPS)
- APAC best-case (soft): $150,000 (APH-ENG)
- Identified gating items: legal redline (1), SOC2 evidence (1), PO delay (1).

Next steps:
1) Finance — please confirm you can close the two finance-closeable deals by end-of-week; if not, state which you will push to next period.
2) Marcus/Laura/Vanessa/Karthik — for any soft items, please provide the buyer contact and ETA for PO or signatures.
3) I'll schedule a 30-min triage with Procurement and Finance tomorrow at 09:00 BST if needed (calendar invite attached).

Attachments sent to finance: consolidated_commit_rollup_20270412.xlsx, draft_MOP_close.docx.

If anyone sees a mismatch between the numbers I’ve aggregated and what you sent, call it out now and I’ll correct the sheet before finance finalizes the ledger.

Thanks —
Mina
